rule_title: TTP 1547.005 - Rogue SSP Loaded into LSA (Non-System32 Path)
description: Detects a Security Support Provider being loaded by LSA from a path outside of System32 — the definitive indicator of a malicious SSP DLL registered for persistence or credential interception. All 420 events in the baseline show only System32 paths. Any SecurityPackageName pointing elsewhere is high fidelity.
